statement: In the prospectively selected held-out bacterium, archaeon, and eukaryote, identical primary-sample MOP token identities will recur in the broad OUTSIDE_GENE <=100-bp boundary role above a null that fixes per-genome token recoverability and boundary-role marginal counts.
support_condition: Observed S_pair_H above null mean and one-sided 100,000-replicate Monte Carlo tail <=0.05; strong support <=0.01.
weakening_condition: Observed above null mean but tail >0.05.
contamination_boundary: Species, assemblies, token universe, boundary definition, statistic, null, seed and thresholds frozen before held-out genome sequence download/scan.
